name: Affection Academy
source:
Jayme just finished his first year of college and it was intense! He doesn't remember much about last year other than the fact that it was extremely difficult and mind-numbingly boring.

But he's put all that behind him and he's ready for some new adventures!

There's just one big problem...he doesn't know where to start. Luckily his two best friends Lucien and Sebastian are here to help and they know exactly what he needs.

Fivesome? Anyone?

[From [url=https://stcrowncrest.itch.io/affection-academy]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Jayme刚刚完成了大学一年级的学习，这真是太紧张了！他对去年的事记不太清了，只记得那一年极其困难且无聊。

但他已经把这一切抛在脑后，准备好迎接新的冒险了！

只有一个大问题……他不知道从哪里开始。幸运的是，他的两个最好的朋友卢西安和塞巴斯蒂安在这里提供帮助，他们确切地知道他需要什么。

五人组？有人吗？

[来自[url=https://stcrowncrest.itch.io/affection-academy]Itch.io[/url]]
